title: Selling Plans Refund Administration Fee Rates by Performance Level
content:
The administration fee withheld from a **Selling Plans** refund credit is charged at a rate that rewards sellers in good recent standing. The rule reads the seller's Seller Performance Standing record: the performance level and the order defect records with their dates.

**Rule.** The refund administration fee rate is the top refund admin rate when the seller's performance level is one of the discount standing levels and the standing record carries no order defect dated within the last recent-defect months, the above refund admin rate when the level is Above Standard Level and no order defect is dated within those months, and the refund administration fee rate otherwise; the months are whole months counted back from the decision date.

The discount standing levels are Top Rated Level and Preferred Partner Level. The recent-defect months are 2 whole months counted back from the decision date, and every order defect counts — negative feedback, guarantee claim, chargeback or seller cancellation, on any order.

## Rate matrix

| Order defects dated within the last 2 whole months | Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | Above Standard Level | Any other level |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 10% (top refund admin rate) | 15% (above refund admin rate) | The plan's refund administration fee rate |
| One or more | The plan's refund administration fee rate | The plan's refund administration fee rate | The plan's refund administration fee rate |

## Hypothetical cases

- Top Rated Level, last defect recorded four months ago → 10%.
- Preferred Partner Level, a negative feedback defect recorded three weeks ago → the plan's refund administration fee rate.
- Above Standard Level, no defects on record → 15%.
